name: v2026.08.01
body:
Automated release from commit `d64c65dfc5a791ab9fb085ad995779bc7ebb9ed2`.
Every architecture was built and verified under QEMU, and x86-64 was
independently rebuilt and compared, before publication. Verify the
SHA-256 files, SBOM, and attestations before deploying, and see
`docs/RELEASING.md` for what this automation does not review.

## What's Changed
* ci: retry transient build failures once by @0typos in https://github.com/0typos/statics/pull/2
* ci: skip the matrix when only documentation changed by @0typos in https://github.com/0typos/statics/pull/4


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/0typos/statics/compare/v2026.07.27...v2026.08.01
